stories.headline: Three Midterms Four Days One Cold Brew
stories.article: Priya survived three midterms in four days. Cold brew kept her going.

stories.headline: Library Desk Officially Declares Residency
stories.article: Priya spent most of the week at one desk in the library. That desk got a lot of company.

panels.scene: Priya sitting at a single library desk with laptop and books, looking settled, medium wide shot from slightly behind with library shelves in background
panels.caption: Home base established in the library.

panels.scene: Priya still at the same library desk at night, leaning on hand, tired but focused, close side angle
panels.caption: Many hours, one very loyal desk.

panels.scene: Priya walking in a campus hallway holding a cold brew cup, eyes wide and relieved, medium shot
panels.caption: Midterm marathon fueled by cold brew.

panels.scene: Priya leaning back at her library desk with empty cold brew cup, smiling with relief, front-facing angle
panels.caption: Three midterms survived, celebration time.
